_readme: Townlapse town registry. Add one entry per town (a pull request is welcome). 'slug' becomes townlapse.org/<slug>; 'url' is where the town's map lives (here, or on its own domain); 'center' is [lat, lng] of the town's middle and 'radius_km' roughly how far it extends, used by the Townlapse apps to show towns near you.

towns.name: Downtown Palo Alto
towns.blurb: 1900 to today. More than 2,000 places, from the 1904 city directory and decades of phone books to today's shops, plus the ones neighbors remembered.
